# repository registration is idempotent by slug

register_repository(slug, ...) called multiple times with the same slug must return the same repository id (no duplicate repo created), even if other fields differ.

Prevent duplicate repository records and ensure repository identity is driven by slug; allow refs/fields to be updated without creating new records.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_storage.py` — `tests.test_storage.test_init_is_idempotent`
